script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying the commander just wants to know what language Paul speaks assigns him a motive the text does not give. He asks whether Paul speaks Greek.
A minute ago adds an interval the passage does not give.
The commander asks whether Paul speaks Greek, but the passage does not say Paul spoke Greek to him.
The passage does not say Hebrew was the crowd's own language.
Paul says he was raised in Jerusalem and educated at Gamaliel's feet, but he does not say where that education took place.
Moses being prominent in Paul's training is not stated in the passage.
Paul says he could see Ananias at that moment, but does not say Ananias was the first thing he saw.
Paul asking questions does not establish that he could talk the whole time.
The passage does not say the crowd cared a lot about the temple.
Paul was headed to Damascus with letters from the high priest, not headed to report to the high priest.
Acts 8:25 does not establish that the Samaritans were outside this crowd's circle.
The explanation is generic: it repeats the order and then says only that it was the order given.
The passage does not say that nobody in the crowd was making sense.
Soldiers were Roman is an overbroad historical claim that the passage does not establish.
The explanation is flat and circular, saying only that slave was not the word and citizen was.
Calling it an afternoon adds a time of day that the text does not give.
